title: Communication n°72/2020
text:
Committee on the Elimination of Racial Discrimination 
 
 Decision adopted by the Committee under article 14 of the 
Convention, concerning communication No. 72/2020**, *** 
Communication submitted by: 
X. and Y. (represented by counsel) 
Alleged victim: 
The authors 
State party: 
Switzerland 
Date of communication: 
12 August 2019 
Substantive issues: 
Discrimination 
 
1. 
The authors of the communication are X and Y, both Swiss citizens. The authors 
allege that the Neuchâtel Law on the Parking of Nomadic Communities, which entered into 
force on 1 April 2018, violates their rights under articles 2, 3, 5, and 6 of the Convention, as 
it interferes with their family life and threatens the Yéniche way of life, including that of 
future generations. The authors are represented by counsel. 
2. 
The Committee notes that on 2 June 2021, 11 November 2021, 3 April 2023, and 24 
November 2025, the Secretariat requested the authors to provide comments on the 
observations of the State party on admissibility and merits of the communication. These 
comments have not been provided. 
 3. 
At its meeting on 23 April 2026, the Committee, having taken note of the State party’s 
observations, the time elapsed since the latest contact with the authors, and the absence of 
any response from the authors commenting on the State party’s observations on the 
communication, decided to discontinue its consideration of communication No. 72/2020. 
 
 
 
 
 
** Adopted by the Committee at its 117th session (13 April – 1 May 2026). 
 
*** The following members of the Committee participated in the examination of the communication: The 
following members of the Committee participated in the examination of the 
communication: Shaikha Al-Misnad, Michal Balcerzak, Pela Boker-Wilson, Chinsung 
Chung, Bakari Sidiki Diaby, Régine Esseneme, Jian Guan, Ibrahima Guisse, Gun Kut, 
Carla Ivette Pousa Caride, Vadili Rayess, Verene Shepherd, Chrispine Gwalawala Sibande, 
Stamatia Stavrinaki, Mazalo Tebie, Faith Dikeledi Pansy Tlakula, Abderrahman Tlemcani 
and Saúl Vicente Vázquez.
